notes: Saved characters are no longer left behind. Installing now carries your characters, settings and calibration forward from an older copy, and there is a new Import button next to Load for bringing them in from anywhere else. The window had a second pass: the status line is now pills, the footer has its own panel, the column headings are set apart, and Auto Attack stopped shouting over START. Fixed wording that had gone stale, including a line that claimed the tool never uses the internet, which stopped being true when Updates arrived.
